notes: Updated journal statistics: a new “Your progress” screen shows your entry distribution across 4 journals, your favorite journal, anxiety levels, and entry trends over the week.

Rubles payments now require you to be logged in.
Premium can now be activated in just a few taps — even without registering
AI dialogues work without logging in if you already have Premium; once you log in, everything is synced to your account
All psychological tests are now free
The light theme now features a warm palette from our new design
Home widgets for the day series have been completely redesigned: clean layouts and accurate streak counting
Fixed the journal: quick edits and adding photos no longer cause crashes
Fixed crashes when opening on iOS 15–17
Restored Sign in with Apple and push notifications
The rating scale has been split into three levels — “Good”, “Great”, and “Perfect” — and updated with new illustrations.
Updated login and onboarding screens: warm backgrounds, a new Apple Sign-in button, and fresh section icons.
Fixed subscription confirmation: purchase receipts are no longer lost on unstable networks and now activate automatically.

Updated course pages and the full course list; internal screen headers now follow a unified layout.

Fixed white flashes when switching to dark theme; canceling auto-renewal no longer revokes access before the end of the paid period.

Filling out your automatic thought journal now feels more like a session with a psychologist. With “Gentle Dialogue,” you can simply describe what happened in your own words — the AI assistant will gently guide you and fill in the necessary journal steps for you. This lets you focus on your memories, thoughts, and feelings in the moment without worrying about the journal’s structure.

A major AI assistant update! Analysis is now just the beginning. We’ve added full interactive dialogue: discuss your insights and work through psychological exercises under the expert guidance of our AI. This is just the first step toward a whole new level of support!
Meet our new exercise section — Breathing Practices! 🧘‍♂️ They’ll help you relieve stress, manage panic, or even boost your energy! ⚡️

Great news: we’ve decided to make the app even more accessible! From today, we’ll be unlocking more Premium features for free use. We’re starting with relaxing sounds: the sleep timer is now free forever!
